messages:
zane: quick ping on PR #8301 — changed small-batch tiling heuristic. canary passed functional tests but p95 tail bumped ~8% on longseq workloads. attaching microbench output. pls flag if this needs revert or quick tweak :eyes:
maya: ack, saw the canary alerts earlier. which config was used? default tiling params?
zane: yes default params + the new dynamic horizon logic. bench run used model=redwood-small, seq=4096, batch=4, 90s steady-state.
bench-bot: benchmark artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/bench/3432105678/artifacts (csv + logs)
ari: can you paste the p50/p95 numbers here? easier to eyeball.
zane: pasted below:
```
metric,p50(ms),p95(ms),throughput(tok/s),gpu_mem(MB)
inference,12.4,86.1,120.5,6340
baseline,11.8,79.6,124.1,6292
delta,+5.1%,+8.1%,-2.9%,+0.8%
```

sam: hm mem delta small but p95 bump is concerning. is this reproducible on local microbench?
zane: reproduced on two canary shards. local repro with the same config shows similar p95 bump on longseq traces; shortseq looks fine.
toni: do we have flamegraphs or perf heatmap for the tail? might be a scheduling stall or KV cache thrash.
maya: uploading quick perf summaries in ~10m. initial guess: dynamic horizon increases prefill variability which can spike KV cache misses for longseq.
ari: if it's cache-related we could try temporary revert of the horizon change and run the same bench to confirm. that would be fastest to validate root cause.
zane: agreed. i can open a revert PR now if we want to block merge. question: do we block merge until fix?
sam: if this regresses SLO p95 on canary and customer traffic we should hold. but if we have a mitigations branch that pins horizon for longseq, maybe we can patch.
toni: can we add a guard: `if seq_len>2048 -> old-horizon` in the change? quick patch might fix without full revert.
maya: i can prototype the guard and run a quick bench tonight. if it nukes perf delta we can merge that instead.
ari: thanks — if maya's patch clears p95 I'll give LGTM. otherwise we'll revert.
zane: thanks all. i'll pause merge and wait for maya's bench. updating PR with benchmark links and steps to repro. :thumbsup:
maya: posting bench results in thread when done. might be 2-3 hours.
bench-bot: CI status: canary cluster steady-state runs complete. regression detected on p95 threshold (8% > 5% alert).
sam: noted. @zane leave a short PR description with rollback instructions so SRE can revert quickly if needed.
zane: done — added rollback steps and a quick command: `./deploy rollback --canary pr-8301`
ari: nice. thanks everyone — keeping eyes on this. :raised_hands:
